name: BlueprintSegment
intent: One cell of a multi-floor blueprint split: a framed blueprint (or a “No blueprint” placeholder), a floor label + % chip, and an optional walk-through button. Tile several to build a split canvas.
when: Tiling several floors into a split blueprint canvas
Showing a single floor's blueprint with its progress % and a walk-through action

chooseOver.because: BlueprintSegment is one cell; BlueprintViewer3 is the full multi-floor viewer template that composes segments

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: label
props.description: Floor / level label shown in the corner chip, e.g. "GF".

props.name: value
props.description: Completion percentage shown next to the label. Omit to hide it.

props.name: plan
props.description: The blueprint / plan node (e.g. an SVG floor plan). When omitted, a "No blueprint" placeholder shows.

props.name: walkthroughLabel
props.description: Accessible label + tooltip for the walk-through button. Default "Walk-through".

props.name: active
props.description: Highlight the segment as active (inset ring). Default false.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the rounded card frame (border / radius / background) so the segment sits seamlessly in a split grid where the parent supplies the dividers. Default false.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Extra classes on the label chip (e.g. to offset it below a floating navigator).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
